intent.description: Use when the user wants to categorize, sort, organize, or suggest renames for files in a local folder such as Downloads, or for files that share one parent directory. Builds a review plan with stable file-family categories, optional whitelist, project-root protection, and dry-run apply; moves or renames only after explicit approval of that plan. Use for 整理文件, 分类归档, Downloads 整理, 重命名建议, 审阅后再移动. Do not use for Git worktree isolation, Windows process cleanup, repository source-layout refactors, duplicate deletion, cloud-drive sync, or installing the AI File Sorter desktop app.

should_trigger: My Downloads folder is a mess. Categorize the files and show a plan first.
帮我整理这个目录里的文件，按类别建文件夹。
Suggest rename ideas for pictures in this folder.
Organize this mixed archive folder with more refined categories.
审阅后再移动这些 Downloads 文件。
Organize files that all live in one parent directory.
should_not_trigger: Create an isolated git worktree for feat/login.
Kill leaked Playwright MCP node processes.
Write a Conventional Commit for the staged auth fix.
Publish the GitHub Release for v1.2.0.
near_neighbor: Restructure src/ in this Node repo so helpers live under lib/.
Install the AI File Sorter desktop app.

trust.side_effect_policy: scan and assemble-plan and apply without --execute are read-only aside from optional JSON outputs; filesystem moves require --execute after this-turn plan_id approval

degradation.openai: metadata-adapter; host must keep --execute behind user approval
degradation.claude: neutral-source-plus-adapter; host remains responsible for filesystem permission
degradation.generic: neutral-source; do not move files without an equivalent confirmation control
degradation.vscode: workspace trust is not authorization to move files

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
